title_ru: AI-Lover — инклюзивный слой сексуальной ориентации, гендерной идентичности и вариаций половых характеристик
purpose: Ensure sexual- and gender-diverse populations are represented in sampling, fairness audits and heterogeneity analysis without treating identity as pathology, addiction mechanism or engagement-targeting signal.

measurement_architecture.principle: Do not collapse sex assigned at birth, current gender, transgender experience, sexual orientation, romantic orientation and intersex traits into one field.
measurement_architecture.reference_standard: National Academies 2022 recommends distinct measurement and a two-step sex-assigned-at-birth plus current-gender approach for identifying transgender experience, while allowing a different self-described term.

sexual_orientation_identity.rule: Standard categories support comparable analysis; ANOTHER_SELF_DESCRIBED_ORIENTATION means the ontology is intentionally open rather than claiming to list every possible orientation.
sexual_orientation_identity.behavior_attraction_identity_separation: Do not infer orientation identity from sexual behavior or attraction variables. Collect behavior/attraction only when directly required by a preregistered research question.

romantic_orientation_optional.scientific_use: Optional for relational/companion-AI studies when preregistered because romantic orientation can differ from sexual orientation.

sex_assigned_at_birth.privacy_note: Do not collect merely to satisfy curiosity; this is sensitive information and may be unnecessary for many AI-Lover analyses.

current_gender_identity.open_vocabulary_rule: The list is not an ontology of all genders. Any participant may use ANOTHER_SELF_DESCRIBED_GENDER; raw free text should be retained only when necessary and consented, otherwise map to a coarse privacy-preserving category.
current_gender_identity.cultural_identity_rule: Culturally specific identities such as Two-Spirit, hijra, fa'afafine, mahu, travesti or other local terms may be represented through self-description or locally validated instruments; never assign them outside their cultural context.

transgender_experience.preferred_measure: two-step sex-assigned-at-birth + current-gender when scientifically necessary and privacy-safe
transgender_experience.rule: Never infer or label an individual as transgender from conversational content.

intersex_variations_in_sex_characteristi.rule: Do not use intersex as a third gender category and do not infer status from anatomy, medical history or conversation without explicit consented data.

pronouns_and_names.research_role: interaction-respect metadata, not causal risk covariates
pronouns_and_names.rule: Do not use pronouns as a proxy for gender classification.

fairness_analysis.primary_question: Does the same measured mechanism produce materially different AI-Lover outcomes across self-identified groups after matching on exposure, baseline impairment, social support, discrimination/minority-stress measures and AI features?
fairness_analysis.promotion_rule: Identity interaction is exploratory until replicated and must not become an engagement-targeting coefficient.

privacy_and_safety.free_text: minimize retention; prefer participant-controlled coarse mapping
privacy_and_safety.withdrawal: participant may decline or withdraw sensitive covariates without losing study participation where feasible

minor_rule.age_13_17: Only ethics-approved minimal-risk SOGI fairness/representation research; no sexual-interest cue deck and no dependency-inducing design.
minor_rule.identity_data: collect only when scientifically necessary, age-appropriate, privacy-protective and ethically approved

external_evidence_anchors.source: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine
external_evidence_anchors.title: Measuring Sex, Gender Identity, and Sexual Orientation
external_evidence_anchors.use: concept separation, inclusive measurement, two-step gender measure, open self-described response

external_evidence_anchors.title: Guide to Taking a Sexual History
external_evidence_anchors.use: sex assigned at birth and current gender are distinct; clinical questions should accommodate individual gender identity and preferences

research_seal: COUNT EVERYONE; TARGET NO ONE. IDENTITY DESCRIBES THE SAMPLE, NOT THE LOOP.
